verified_facts.text: Hotel Las Islas is located on the seafront within the Rosario Islands National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: located on the seafront within the Rosario Islands National Park

verified_facts.text: The boat ride from the La Bodeguita dock in Cartagena to the hotel takes approximately 45 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The boat ride from the La Bodeguita dock in Cartagena to the hotel takes approximately 45 minutes.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heliport and offers helicopter service to and from Cartagena, with an approximate flight time of 18 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: We offer helicopter service to and from Cartagena, with an approximate flight time of 18 minutes.

verified_facts.text: The journey by private vehicle from Rafael Nunez International Airport takes approximately 90 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The journey from Rafael Núñez International Airport takes approximately 90 minutes.

verified_facts.text: The treetop bungalows are either eight or 12 meters above the ground and include a furnished deck with a hammock and a hydromassage Jacuzzi tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: are either eight or 12 meters above the ground. They include a furnished deck with a hammock and a hydromassage Jacuzzi tub

verified_facts.text: The sea level bungalows have a private pool and a furnished deck with a hammock, sun loungers and a dining area.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private pool and a furnished deck with a hammock, sun loungers and a dining area

verified_facts.text: The Grand Family Bungalow is a two-bedroom bungalow at sea level with a private pool, and each room has its own bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: located at sea level with private pool. Accommodation with two bedrooms

verified_facts.text: Each bungalow is named after a Colombian island.
verified_facts.excerpt: cada Bungalow identificado con el nombre de una isla colombiana

verified_facts.text: Isleta is a private island that is part of the hotel, with a white sand beach, and the transfer is free for guests subject to availability.
verified_facts.excerpt: This private island is part of hotel Las Islas. It has a white sand beach

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs a bioluminescent plankton night tour to the beaches near Cholon.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tour the beaches near Cholón, where you will jump into shallow waters near the mangroves and observe plankton

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a stargazing deck with a Celestron CGX-L telescope, and the astrotour is a courtesy for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Through our Celestron CGX-L telescope, you can explore the solar system and deep space. This activity is an exclusive courtesy for our guests.

verified_facts.text: A local Barú cook teaches cooking classes in traditional regional dishes such as ceviche.
verified_facts.excerpt: Learn to prepare traditional regional dishes such as ceviche, shrimp cocktails, and fried dishes from a local Barú cook.

verified_facts.text: The snorkeling tour departs from the hotel's reception dock to a point in the Corales del Rosario National Natural Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The tour departs from our reception dock to a designated point in the Corales del Rosario National Natural Park

verified_facts.text: Spa Niña Daniela is a beachfront spa designed by a local architect.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by a renowned local architect, the hotel’s beachfront spa and wellness center

verified_facts.text: The spa's wellness center has a thalassotherapy pool, jacuzzi, sauna and Turkish bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wellness center has a thalassotherapy pool, jacuzzi, sauna and Turkish bath.

verified_facts.text: The spa uses Biologique Recherche and SOTHYS products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa Niña Daniela has an exclusive line of products Biologique Recherche and SOTHYS

verified_facts.text: Las Guacas restaurant serves dinner surrounded by vegetation and orchids, with Colombian and international specialties.
verified_facts.excerpt: A place for dinner surrounded by vegetation and orchids. Colombian and international gastronomy specialties of our executive chef.

verified_facts.text: Las Islas Bar is on the third floor of the Club House with a 360-degree view over the hotel complex.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the third floor of the Club House, with a 360° view over the hotel complex.

verified_facts.text: Choco Bar & Restaurant is the beach restaurant and bar, specializing in oven pizzas and grilled seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach restaurant and bar, specialty: oven pizzas, sandwiches, skewers and grilled seafood.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's cuisine is fresh and seasonal, with an emphasis on fish and local products.
verified_facts.excerpt: create fresh, seasonal cuisine with an emphasis on fish and local products

verified_facts.text: The Sunset in Casa Navegante is a two-hour boat tour toward Cienaga de Cholon, aboard a boat with a jacuzzi, bar and lounge areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique two-hour tour departs every evening towards Ciénaga de Cholón

verified_facts.text: Hotel Las Islas has planted mangroves as an environmental initiative.
verified_facts.excerpt: initiatives like mangrove planting, a tangible gesture to regenerate the ecosystem around us

verified_facts.text: Hotel Las Islas was a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards honoree in 2019 and 2021.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2019, 2021
